# Permission allow-list for every release-type APK (dev, beta, prod).
# Checked by .github/scripts/check_permissions.py in `Build` and
# `release.yml` (security review SEC-6, SEC-20, REL-3). Any addition or
# removal fails the build; a wanted change is reviewed (Play Data Safety,
# Advertising-ID declaration) and made here in the same PR.
# ${applicationId} = the app's own package (".dev" for dev).
#
# Confirmed against the first flavored CI build (Build run 37922551104,
# probe-dash-dev-23.apk, 2026-10-09). Two guessed entries were not in the
# real APK and were removed: RECEIVE_BOOT_COMPLETED and the declared
# `permission ${applicationId}.DYNAMIC_RECEIVER_NOT_EXPORTED_PERMISSION`
# (the APK only has the uses-permission line).

# App (spec A-29 haptics).
uses-permission android.permission.VIBRATE

# google_mobile_ads plugin + Google Mobile Ads SDK / UMP.
uses-permission android.permission.INTERNET
uses-permission android.permission.ACCESS_NETWORK_STATE
uses-permission com.google.android.gms.permission.AD_ID
uses-permission android.permission.ACCESS_ADSERVICES_AD_ID
uses-permission android.permission.ACCESS_ADSERVICES_ATTRIBUTION
uses-permission android.permission.ACCESS_ADSERVICES_TOPICS

# androidx.work (pulled in by the Ads SDK for offline pings).
uses-permission android.permission.WAKE_LOCK
uses-permission android.permission.FOREGROUND_SERVICE

# androidx.core >= 1.9: guards non-exported dynamic receivers.
uses-permission ${applicationId}.DYNAMIC_RECEIVER_NOT_EXPORTED_PERMISSION
